observations: Camera body visible with 'Canon' and 'EOS' logos legible on the body (photo 0)
Separate kit lens shown marked 'Canon 15-45mm IMAGE STABILIZER' (photo 0)
Retail box behind the gear reads 'EOS M50 EF-M15-45 IS STM Kit' with Canon logo (photo 0)
Body mount is covered by a rear lens cap; no sensor, mount, or LCD screen visible
No battery, charger, memory card, strap, or cables visible in the photo
No power-on, screen-open, or shutter-count shot provided
Image has a visible watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / GOODNESS CONNECT', consistent with a reposted/stock-style listing photo rather than a fresh condition photo

claims.evidence: Body and box text in photo 0 match this model name

claims.claim: Produce incredible high-resolution, cinematic video footage with...
claims.evidence: Marketing language; no video sample or on-screen footage shown

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have sensor/shutter fault
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, showing live view on screen, and taking a photo/video

risks.risk: Flip-out LCD screen could be cracked or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo/video of screen opened and displaying image

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy prior use despite cosmetic look
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EOSInfo-type app

risks.risk: Missing battery, charger, or memory card reduces usability
risks.proof: Photo showing battery, charger, and card alongside the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body/lens only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Lens autofocus or image stabilization may be faulty
risks.proof: Video showing autofocus acquiring focus and IS engaging

risks.risk: Box may not match the actual camera serial (box-swap risk)
risks.proof: Photo of serial number sticker on box matched to serial shown on camera body/battery compartment
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified match, box excluded from value

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and showing live view on the LCD/EVF
Shutter count screenshot or app reading
Photo of battery, charger, and memory card included
Close-up of camera serial number matching box serial
Close-up photos of lens mount, sensor area, and any dents/scratches
response.reason: Identity is clearly readable from the body and box, but no functional proof (power-on, screen, shutter count) is shown, so the kit must be priced at worst case as an untested body-and-lens set pending verification.
